title.zh: 卡在憲法10天期限的最後一天，卓榮泰副署了在野版無人機條例——9/6報告與9/8報告追的政治測試終於落地；同一週，伊朗發動開戰以來最大規模的一日攻船潮、CENTCOM第三度駁斥『擊中美艦』，Sandworm與Qilin則在同一個CVSS 10.0的Cisco防火牆管理漏洞上會師
title.en: On the Last Legally Possible Day, Cho Jung-tai Countersigns the Opposition's Drone Act — the Political Test 9/6報告 and 9/8報告 Tracked Finally Lands; the Same Week, Iran Launches the War's Biggest One-Day Wave of Shipping Attacks as CENTCOM Denies 'We Hit US Ships' for a Third Straight Round, While Sandworm and Qilin Converge on the Same CVSS-10.0 Cisco Firewall Flaw

focus.zh: 本期焦點：9/11，行政院秘書長張惇涵宣布卓榮泰已副署8/26-27立法院三讀的在野版《強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例》——法案9/2送達行政院，憲法規定10日內須公布，9/11正是最後期限。這是9/6報告點名、9/8報告觀察到方向已浮現的政治測試第一次真正落地：在野黨把自己已表決通過的法案，變成卡住NT$1,457億追加預算的槓桿，這次證實有效。卓榮泰同時公開表示要「堅守行政院預算權」，代表下一個摩擦點會落在追加預算逐項審查的細節上，而非法案本身。伊朗端：9/9-9/10，伊朗發動Reuters形容為開戰以來規模最大的一日攻船潮，IRGC宣稱同時打了10艘船(含2艘美軍艦、8艘油輪)，CENTCOM再次全數駁斥「擊中美艦」的說法為假——這是9/8報告設下審慎判斷後，第三輪同一模式的重複；但UKMTO獨立證實至少數艘商船遭癱瘓性攻擊，一艘船在杜拜外海造成船員死亡，這是本輪衝突第一起獨立確認的人員死亡。Brent原油9/10一度衝上每桶108美元(5月19日以來新高)，9/11回落至106.11美元，距9/15-16 FOMC僅剩數日。資安端：Cisco Talos 9/9揭露三個活動集群同時利用CVSS滿分10.0的FMC防火牆管理中心認證繞過漏洞CVE-2026-20079，其中UAT-11823被高信度歸因為俄羅斯軍事情報組織Sandworm(部署Cyclops Blink)，UAT-11988則被高信度歸因為Qilin勒索軟體——這是本站8/28與9/6報告追蹤的同一個Qilin集團，六週內第三種完全不同類型的入口(聯邦執法伺服器→AI閘道器→網路邊界管理平面)。科技治理端：眾院H.R. 8800與參院S. 4784版本的FY2027國防授權法案(NDAA)協商仍在進行，其中要求致命武力必須繫於「可辨識的人」的條款，正是五角大廈自己不願對Anthropic鬆口的那條紅線，這場拉鋸現在同時在法院、行政部門與國會三個戰場進行。軍事端：Reuters獨家披露，今年春天美、英、挪三國海軍在Svalbard外海攔下正在演練「切斷海纜卻不留指紋」新技術的俄羅斯GUGI潛艦，事隔五個多月才對外公開。科技端：Reuters獨家報導，Huawei與Cambricon兩個月內把旗艦AI晶片價格上調20%至50%，原因是灰市HBM記憶體價格墊高，美方對先進HBM的出口管制正在間接推升中國國產替代方案的成本。
focus.en: This cycle's focus: on 9/11, Executive Yuan Secretary-General Chang Tun-han announced that Premier Cho Jung-tai had countersigned the opposition's Act on Strengthening Defense Autonomy and Developing the Unmanned Vehicles Industry, passed by the legislature on 8/26-27 — the bill reached the Cabinet on 9/2, and the Constitution requires promulgation within 10 days, making 9/11 the hard deadline. This is the first real landing of the political test our 9/6 report named and our 9/8 report saw taking direction: the opposition turned a bill it had already passed into leverage over the NT$145.7bn supplementary budget, and this time the leverage worked. Cho simultaneously insisted the Cabinet will 'hold firm on its budget authority,' signaling the next friction point sits in the line-by-line review of the supplementary budget, not the act itself. On Iran: 9/9-9/10 saw what Reuters called the war's largest one-day wave of shipping attacks — the IRGC claimed it hit 10 vessels at once (including 2 US warships and 8 tankers), and CENTCOM again denied every 'we hit a US ship' claim as false — the third straight round of the exact pattern our 9/8 report first treated with caution. But UKMTO independently confirmed several commercial vessels disabled by attack, and a seafarer was killed off Dubai — this conflict's first independently confirmed fatality. Brent crude briefly topped $108/barrel on 9/10 (its highest since May 19) before easing to $106.11 on 9/11, days ahead of the 9/15-16 FOMC meeting. On cyber: Cisco Talos disclosed on 9/9 that three distinct intrusion clusters are exploiting the CVSS-10.0 authentication-bypass flaw CVE-2026-20079 in its Secure Firewall Management Center — one, UAT-11823, attributed with high confidence to Russian military-intelligence group Sandworm (deploying Cyclops Blink), another, UAT-11988, attributed with high confidence to Qilin ransomware, the same crew our 8/28 and 9/6 reports tracked breaching a federal law-enforcement server and an AI gateway — its third distinct entry-point category in six weeks. On tech governance: the House's H.R. 8800 and Senate's S. 4784 versions of the FY2027 NDAA remain in conference, carrying a provision requiring lethal force stay tied to an 'identifiable human' — precisely the red line the Pentagon won't concede to Anthropic — now fought simultaneously in courts, the executive branch, and Congress. On the military front, a Reuters exclusive revealed that this spring, US, UK and Norwegian navies intercepted Russian GUGI submarines near Svalbard rehearsing a 'sever cables without fingerprints' capability, disclosed publicly only now, five-plus months later. On tech: a separate Reuters exclusive reports Huawei and Cambricon have raised flagship AI chip prices 20-50% within two months, as grey-market HBM costs climb — Washington's advanced-HBM export controls are indirectly driving up the cost of China's domestic alternatives.

title.zh: 國會想在NDAA裡寫下國防部自己不願簽的那條線：致命武力必須繫於『可辨識的人』——這正是Hegseth要Anthropic撤掉的紅線，現在同時在法院、行政部門與國會三個戰場開打
title.en: Congress Is Trying to Write Into the NDAA the Line the Pentagon Itself Won't Concede: Lethal Force Must Stay Tied to an 'Identifiable Human' — Exactly What Hegseth Wants Anthropic to Drop, Now Fought in Courts, the Executive Branch and Congress at Once

summary.zh: 眾議院已通過的H.R. 8800與參議院已通過的S. 4784，是FY2027國防授權法案(NDAA)的兩個版本，目前正由參眾軍事委員會協商成統一文本；其中一項條款(常被引述為Section 1653)要求國防部長訂定規則，確保武力使用——包括涉及自主AI能力的情況——始終繫於一名「可辨識的人」。AI Policy Network(AIPN)9月初致函軍事委員會兩黨領袖，敦促協商代表在最終文本中保留包括「武力使用的人為監督」、「大型AI承包商的事故與內部威脅通報」、「國防部AGI準備倡議」與「先進AI晶片出口管制」等多項條款；國家安全與AI政策界人士也曾在委員會審查前公開呼籲保留此類人為監督條款。這與今年6月由參議員Chris Coons(對外撥款小組資深成員)與Jack Reed(參院軍事委員會資深成員)另外提出的《國防人工智慧負責任使用法案》方向一致——該法要求自主AI系統在達到可靠性門檻前，人類操作者須能監控、偵測異常並手動關閉系統，並明文禁止將軍用AI用於境內民眾的大規模監控。協商程序尚未完成，最終文本可能與現有兩院版本有出入。
summary.en: H.R. 8800 (passed by the House) and S. 4784 (passed by the Senate) are the two chambers' versions of the FY2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), now being reconciled by the Armed Services Committees in conference. One provision — often cited as Section 1653 — directs the Secretary of Defense to issue regulations ensuring the use of force, including where autonomous AI capabilities are involved, remains tied to an identifiable human. The AI Policy Network (AIPN) wrote to the committees' bipartisan leadership in early September urging conferees to preserve, among other provisions, human oversight of the use of force, incident and insider-threat reporting requirements for large AI contractors, a Defense Department AGI Preparedness Initiative, and export controls on advanced AI chips; national-security and AI-policy figures had separately called for such human-oversight language ahead of committee markup. This lines up with the direction of the separate Responsible Artificial Intelligence in Defense Act, introduced in June by Senators Chris Coons (ranking member on Defense Appropriations) and Jack Reed (ranking member on Senate Armed Services), which would require human operators to be able to monitor, detect anomalies in, and manually disengage autonomous AI systems until they meet a reliability threshold, and explicitly bars military AI from being used for mass domestic surveillance of people in the US. The conference process is not complete, and the final text may differ from either chamber's current version.

implication.zh: 把這條放進本站追了七個月的Anthropic-五角大廈爭議裡看，會看到同一個實質問題現在同時在三個戰場開打，而不是一場已經分出勝負的官司。9/2報告記錄的加州地院裁決，解決的只是程序問題(國防部有沒有正當程序、有沒有報復動機)，完全沒碰觸「AI供應商能不能對自主致命目標選定與境內監控設下不可退讓的紅線」這個實質爭議；9/6報告證實國防部靠著換一條法律路徑(DC巡迴案)，讓「供應鏈風險」標籤在敗訴後依然有效；9/10報告則記錄國防部同時開放Grok、ChatGPT供內部使用，用行動告訴市場自己有替代選項。現在，國會正試圖用立法手段，把Anthropic當初想用契約條款守住的那條線(自主致命目標選定需要人為介入、不得用於境內大規模監控)，直接寫成國防部長必須遵守的法定義務——這代表如果NDAA最終文本保留Section 1653與類似條款，Anthropic的紅線會第一次不再只靠一家公司的商業意願撐著，而是不論DC巡迴案怎麼判、不論國防部往後想找哪家供應商，都必須遵守的法律要求；反過來，如果協商代表在最終文本中把這些條款拿掉或稀釋(而國防部近幾個月一路展現的立場，正是傾向要求承包商接受AI模型可用於『所有合法用途』)，則代表行政部門目前為止在法院跟國會兩條戰線上都還沒真正輸過一次——這條紅線能撐多久，仍然完全取決於Anthropic自己的意願。對你跟決策者對話而言，可以直接引用的具體框架是：這已經不是一家AI公司跟五角大廈的商業糾紛，而是一場正在三個政府部門之間同時進行、尚無明確贏家的權力分立測試。
implication.en: Set against the Anthropic-Pentagon dispute this outlet has tracked for seven months, this shows the same substantive question now being fought on three fronts at once, not a fight that's already been decided. The California district court ruling logged in our 9/2 report resolved only a procedural question — did the government follow due process, was there retaliatory motive — never touching the substantive dispute over whether an AI vendor can hold a non-negotiable red line against autonomous lethal targeting and domestic surveillance. Our 9/6 report confirmed the Pentagon kept the 'supply chain risk' label in effect after that loss simply by switching to a parallel legal track (the D.C. Circuit appeal); our 9/10 report logged the Pentagon opening Grok and ChatGPT to its own workforce, signaling through action that it has alternatives. Now Congress is trying to do by statute what Anthropic originally tried to hold by contract — requiring human involvement in autonomous lethal targeting, barring military AI from mass domestic surveillance — as a binding legal obligation on the Secretary of Defense rather than one vendor's policy. If the final NDAA text keeps Section 1653 and similar language, Anthropic's red line would for the first time no longer rest on one company's commercial willingness to hold it — it would bind regardless of how the D.C. Circuit rules or which vendor the Pentagon prefers going forward. Conversely, if conferees strip or dilute these provisions — and the administration's posture so far has consistently pushed contractors to accept 'any lawful use' of their models — it means the executive branch hasn't actually lost on either front yet, courts or Congress, and how long this red line survives still depends entirely on Anthropic's own resolve. The concrete framing worth citing in conversation with policymakers: this stopped being a commercial dispute between one AI company and the Pentagon and is now a live separation-of-powers contest across three branches of government, with no clear winner yet.

counterpoint.zh: NDAA協商程序目前仍在進行，眾院版與參院版在具體條文用語上仍有落差，過去幾年的NDAA協商史顯示，涉及AI監督與武器系統的條款確實可能在最終協商階段被大幅稀釋或整條拿掉，不宜把目前任一版本的文字當成既定結果；另外，Section 1653本身的用語是要求「規則制定」與「人為監督直到達到可靠性門檻」，這類條款通常給國防部相當大的解釋空間，即使條款保留，實際執行力道仍取決於後續行政規則怎麼寫，不必然真正限制國防部現有的政策方向。《國防人工智慧負責任使用法案》本身也尚未在任一院通過，目前仍是獨立法案，與NDAA協商是兩條平行、進度不同步的軌道，不宜混為一談。
counterpoint.en: The NDAA conference process is still ongoing, and the House and Senate versions still differ in specific statutory language; past NDAA conference cycles show that AI-oversight and weapons-system provisions can be substantially watered down or dropped entirely at the final negotiating stage, so neither chamber's current text should be treated as a settled outcome. Section 1653 itself is worded around 'rulemaking' and 'human oversight until a reliability threshold is met' — language of this kind typically leaves the Pentagon considerable room for interpretation, so even if the provision survives, how much it actually constrains existing policy will depend on the implementing regulations that follow, not the statutory text alone. The Responsible Artificial Intelligence in Defense Act itself has not passed either chamber and remains a separate bill on its own, unsynchronized track from the NDAA conference — the two shouldn't be conflated as one and the same effort.

items.source: AI Policy Network(AIPN)致眾參軍事委員會公開信；Sen. Chris Coons／Sen. Jack Reed官方新聞稿；經Axios、The Hill、Akin Gump法律分析轉述

title.zh: 卡在憲法10天期限的最後一天：卓榮泰副署在野版無人機條例，9/6報告與9/8報告追的政治測試終於落地——但他同時說『追加預算該怎麼審就怎麼審』
title.en: Down to the Constitutional Deadline's Last Day: Cho Jung-tai Countersigns the Opposition's Drone Act — the Political Test 9/6報告 and 9/8報告 Tracked Finally Lands, but He's Already Signaling the Budget Fight Isn't Over

summary.zh: 行政院秘書長張惇涵9/11上午召開記者會證實，行政院長卓榮泰已副署8/26-27立法院三讀通過的在野版《強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例》。法案於9/2送達行政院，依憲法規定總統應於收到後10日內公布，9/11正是最後期限。張惇涵同時表示，立法院既然決定改用年度預算方式辦理無人載具建置，行政院就會「堅守行政院預算權」與「國家機密受最嚴密保護」兩大原則，並盼望上週已送出、其中編列559億元無人載具經費的NT$1,457億追加預算案能儘速在立法院通過。KMT黨團隨後回應，稱此次副署「證明政府不必特別預算常態化」的說法成立。
summary.en: Executive Yuan Secretary-General Chang Tun-han held a press conference on the morning of 9/11 confirming that Premier Cho Jung-tai had countersigned the opposition's Act on Strengthening Defense Autonomy and Developing the Unmanned Vehicles Industry, passed by the legislature on third reading on 8/26-27. The bill reached the Executive Yuan on 9/2, and the Constitution requires promulgation within 10 days of receipt, making 9/11 the final deadline. Chang said that since the legislature chose to fund uncrewed-systems procurement through the annual budget process, the Cabinet would hold firm on two principles — its own budget authority and the strictest protection of state secrets — and hoped the NT$145.7bn supplementary budget submitted last week, which includes NT$55.9bn for uncrewed systems, would clear the legislature quickly. The KMT caucus responded that the countersigning 'proves the government didn't need to normalize special budgets.'

implication.zh: 這直接證實了9/6報告當時點名的政治測試：『行政院是否在政治壓力下加速公告施行在野版條例，讓在野黨的綁法案策略得到正向回饋』，也接上了9/8報告觀察到方向已浮現但尚未落地的判斷。這次的結果不是『傳出擬副署』，而是真正簽署公告——而且是卡在憲法10天期限的最後一天才完成，這個時間點本身值得記一筆：如果行政院是想儘早展現讓步姿態換取預算過關，理論上不必等到最後一天；拖到期限盡頭，更可能代表行政院內部一路談判、拉鋸到不能再拖的那一刻才鬆手，而不是輕易妥協。無論如何，最終結果證實了在野黨的槓桿確實有效：他們找到一個可重複使用的操作模式(把自己已表決通過、行政部門尚未公告施行的法案，當成卡住另一筆錢的籌碼)，且這次成功換到行政院的正式讓步。對你評估台灣防務資金可預測性，接下來真正該盯的不是這筆559億元本身會不會通過(方向已經確定)，而是卓榮泰同時喊出的『堅守行政院預算權』會不會變成新的摩擦點——如果立法院要求逐項、逐案審查這筆無人載具經費(而不是整包通過)，實際撥款到位的時間仍可能比帳面上的『已副署』時程再拖上數月。
implication.en: This directly confirms the political test our 9/6 report named — whether the Executive Yuan accelerates promulgation of the opposition's act under political pressure, rewarding the opposition's bill-linking tactic — and follows through on the direction our 9/8 report saw emerging but not yet landed. This time it isn't 'reportedly leaning toward countersigning'; it's an actual signed promulgation, and it landed on the very last day the Constitution's 10-day clock allowed — a timing detail worth logging on its own. If the Cabinet had wanted to demonstrate an early concession to unlock the budget, it had no reason to wait until the deadline's final day; running the clock down more likely means internal negotiation and resistance continued right up to the point where no further delay was legally possible, rather than an easy capitulation. Either way, the outcome confirms the opposition's leverage actually worked: it found a repeatable tactic — turning a bill it already passed, which the executive hadn't yet promulgated, into a hostage for a separate pot of money — and this time it extracted a formal concession from the Cabinet. For assessing the predictability of Taiwan's defense funding, what's worth watching now isn't whether the NT$55.9bn itself clears (that direction is settled) — it's whether Cho's parallel insistence on 'holding firm on budget authority' becomes the next friction point. If the legislature demands a line-by-line, case-by-case review of this uncrewed-systems funding rather than passing it as a package, actual disbursement could still lag the 'already countersigned' headline by months.

counterpoint.zh: 在憲法期限的最後一天才副署，也可以有另一種較不政治化的讀法：10天本身就是一個法定的、與政治操作無關的硬期限，行政院或許只是需要用完整個法定審查窗口做內部法律確認，未必是刻意拖到不能再拖才讓步；KMT黨團『證明不必特別預算常態化』的說法，本身是帶有政治立場的自我表態，並非中立評估——年度追加預算與八年期特別預算在審查密度、跨年度規劃穩定性上仍有實質差異，簡化成『特別預算沒必要』可能忽略了改用年度預算後，後續每年都要重新面對相同政治槓桿風險的隱藏成本。
counterpoint.en: Signing on the constitutional deadline's exact last day also admits a less politically-charged reading: the 10-day window is itself a hard, apolitical legal deadline, and the Cabinet may simply have needed the full statutory review period for internal legal vetting rather than deliberately running the clock down before conceding. The KMT caucus's claim that this 'proves special budgets weren't necessary' is itself a partisan framing, not a neutral assessment — an annual supplementary budget and an eight-year special budget differ substantially in review intensity and multi-year planning stability, and reducing this to 'the special budget wasn't needed' risks overlooking the hidden cost of now facing the same political-leverage risk anew every single year under the annual-budget track.

items.source: 聯合新聞網、自由時報、中時對行政院秘書長張惇涵9/11記者會的報導

title.zh: 開戰以來最大規模的一日攻船潮：伊朗宣稱同時打了10艘船，UKMTO獨立證實至少一名船員在杜拜外海身亡——CENTCOM第三度駁斥『擊中美艦』，模式與9/8報告、9/10報告完全一致
title.en: The War's Biggest One-Day Wave of Shipping Attacks Yet: Iran Claims It Hit 10 Vessels at Once, UKMTO Independently Confirms a Seafarer Killed Off Dubai — CENTCOM Denies 'We Hit US Ships' for a Third Straight Round, Exactly Matching the Pattern in 9/8報告 and 9/10報告

summary.zh: 延續9/10報告記錄的升級軌跡：9/9-9/10，伊朗發動Reuters形容為『開戰以來雙方最大規模的一輪對等攻船潮』的行動。IRGC宣稱在霍爾木茲海峽周邊同時攻擊10艘船，其中包括2艘美軍艦、8艘油輪，另有若干艘船被列為『不遵守伊朗9/6宣布的通行規範』而遭警告或攻擊；CENTCOM隨即全數駁斥，重申沒有任何一艘美國海軍艦艇遭擊中、IRGC所有嘗試攻擊均失敗——與9/8報告記錄的『擊中兩艘驅逐艦』說法遭CENTCOM『完全是假的』駁斥屬同一套劇本。但這次UKMTO(英國海事貿易行動處，獨立於美、伊雙方的第三方機構)獨立記錄了波斯灣北部與阿曼灣有多艘商船遭癱瘓性攻擊、一艘船在Port Rashid外海傾斜、一艘貨輪在al-Faw東南方遭擊中；Reuters並報導一名船員在杜拜外海的攻擊中死亡——這是本輪衝突目前第一起獨立確認的人員死亡。同一時間，Brent原油9/10盤中一度衝上每桶108美元、創5月19日以來新高，9/11回落至106.11美元(單日跌1.41%)；美國能源部長此前指出，週一霍爾木茲原油運量仍達1,700萬桶、為開戰以來紀錄新高，顯示風險溢價與實際運量同步走高的現象持續存在。距9/15-16 FOMC會議僅剩數日。
summary.en: Following the escalation trajectory our 9/10 report documented: on 9/9-9/10, Iran launched what Reuters called the largest round of tit-for-tat shipping attacks by either side since the war began. The IRGC claimed it simultaneously struck 10 vessels around the Strait of Hormuz, including 2 US Navy vessels and 8 tankers, with several other vessels warned or attacked for allegedly failing to comply with the transit regime Iran declared on 9/6. CENTCOM immediately denied all of it, reiterating that no US Navy vessel was struck and that every IRGC attempt failed — the same script as CENTCOM's 'completely FALSE' denial of the 'we hit two destroyers' claim our 9/8 report logged. But this time UKMTO (the UK Maritime Trade Operations office, a third party independent of both the US and Iran) independently recorded several commercial vessels disabled by attack in the northern Gulf and Gulf of Oman, a vessel listing off Port Rashid, and a cargo ship struck southeast of al-Faw; Reuters separately reported a seafarer killed in an attack off Dubai — this conflict's first independently confirmed fatality so far. Brent crude briefly topped $108/barrel intraday on 9/10, its highest since May 19, before easing to $106.11 on 9/11 (down 1.41% on the day); the US Energy Secretary had previously noted Monday's Hormuz crude transit volume still hit a wartime record of 17 million barrels, showing risk premium and actual throughput continuing to rise together. The 9/15-16 FOMC meeting is now just days away.

implication.zh: 這條線索把9/8報告設下的審慎判斷，跟9/10報告已經驗證過一次的模式，再往前推進一輪：IRGC聲稱擊中美軍艦這件事，到目前為止已經連續三輪(9/6、9/8、9/10這次)被CENTCOM明確、公開地否認，形成一個穩定、可追蹤的紀錄——在得到獨立第三方或CENTCOM證實之前，IRGC的『擊中美艦』說法應被視為系統性地不可信，而不是逐次個案評估。但這次多了一個此前沒有的、真正獨立的資料點：UKMTO(不受美、伊任一方控制)證實的商船癱瘓性攻擊與船員死亡。這代表你該把這場衝突拆成兩條完全不同信度的追蹤線來看：一條是『美伊軍事宣傳戰』(IRGC對美艦的攻擊宣稱，目前為止0比4，全部未經證實)，另一條是『商船航運實際風險』(現在有獨立第三方確認的癱瘓性攻擊，且已出現本輪衝突第一起確認死亡)——後者才是真正在惡化、且已經造成人命代價的那一條線，油價的持續走高(5月以來新高)正是市場對這條線的定價，而不是對前者的定價。對你判斷風險胃納與能源價格路徑，接下來兩週最值得盯的不是雙方又互相宣稱了什麼，而是UKMTO這類獨立通報的商船遇襲頻率是否持續上升——這比任何一方的官方說法都更早告訴你航運風險的真實斜率。
implication.en: This thread advances the caution our 9/8 report set and the pattern our 9/10 report already verified once, one round further: IRGC's claims of hitting US warships have now been explicitly and publicly denied by CENTCOM across three consecutive rounds (9/6, 9/8, and now 9/10), forming a stable, trackable record — until independently corroborated, IRGC's 'we hit a US ship' claims should be treated as systematically unreliable by default, not re-assessed case by case each time. But this round adds a genuinely new, independent data point that wasn't there before: UKMTO — controlled by neither the US nor Iran — confirming disabling attacks on commercial vessels and a seafarer's death. That means this conflict should now be tracked as two lines with entirely different reliability: one is the 'US-Iran military propaganda war' (IRGC's claims against US warships, now 0-for-4 and never corroborated); the other is 'actual commercial shipping risk' (now independently confirmed to be worsening, with this round's confirmed fatality). It's the latter line that is genuinely deteriorating and now carries a human cost — the oil price's continued climb (a new high since May) is the market pricing that line, not the former. For gauging risk appetite and the oil-price path, what's worth watching over the next two weeks isn't what either side claims next — it's whether the frequency of independently reported (UKMTO-style) attacks on commercial vessels keeps rising, since that tells you the real slope of shipping risk earlier than any official statement from either side.

counterpoint.zh: IRGC宣稱的『10艘船』本身混雜了至少三種不同性質的目標：2艘遭否認的美軍艦攻擊、若干艘遭實際攻擊或癱瘓的油輪與貨輪、以及若干艘僅被列為『不遵守伊朗劃定通行規範』的船隻(這類說法可能只是主權宣示性質的警告，未必構成實際攻擊)——把這三種類別混為一個『10艘』的單一數字，可能高估了這輪攻擊的實際強度與範圍。另外，UKMTO記錄的船員死亡與船體受損事件，目前尚未有具名的獨立調查將其明確歸咎於伊朗方面(UKMTO通常只記錄事件本身，不必然做出歸因判斷)，在有更明確的歸因資訊前，不宜將其自動視為『伊朗蓄意造成人員死亡』的既定事實。
counterpoint.en: IRGC's claimed '10 vessels' bundles together at least three different categories of target: 2 denied attacks on US warships, some tankers and cargo ships genuinely struck or disabled, and some vessels merely flagged as 'non-compliant with Iran's declared transit regime' (which may be no more than a sovereignty-assertion warning rather than an actual attack) — collapsing these three categories into one '10-vessel' figure risks overstating this round's actual intensity and scope. Separately, the seafarer death and vessel damage UKMTO recorded have not yet been tied to Iran by any named independent investigation (UKMTO typically logs incidents without necessarily making an attribution call); absent clearer attribution, this shouldn't automatically be treated as an established fact that Iran deliberately caused a fatality.

items.source: Reuters（經U.S. News、GlobalSecurity.org「Iran War 2026 Day 195」、CNBC轉述）；CENTCOM聲明；UKMTO事故通報

title.zh: 同一個CVSS滿分10.0的Cisco防火牆管理漏洞，Sandworm跟Qilin各自用不同手法會師：俄羅斯軍事情報與勒索軟體集團，現在共用同一個入口
title.en: The Same CVSS-10.0 Cisco Firewall-Management Flaw, Exploited by Sandworm and Qilin Each in Their Own Way: Russian Military Intelligence and a Ransomware Crew Now Share the Same Front Door

summary.zh: Cisco Talos 9/9揭露正在追蹤三個各自獨立的入侵活動集群，都在利用Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center(FMC，用於集中管理旗下防火牆設備群的控制平面軟體)的兩項漏洞：CVE-2026-20079(CVSS滿分10.0，未經驗證的認證繞過，可讓遠端攻擊者以root權限執行任意指令)與CVE-2026-20316(CVSS 5.3，攻擊者可用內建的靜態、硬編碼憑證直接登入取得低權限存取，可與前者串接以提升權限)。第一個集群UAT-12197利用CVE-2026-20079在Cisco Security Manager的Tomcat webroot植入名為home.jsp的JSP後門，再部署一支以Java Archive撰寫的指令執行器cmd.jar，並利用FMC內建的OmniQuery.pl工具查詢使用者資料表竊取帳號憑證。第二個集群UAT-11823被Talos高信度歸因為俄羅斯軍事情報單位相關的Sandworm，部署過去曾用於劫持WatchGuard等網路設備組成殭屍網路的Cyclops Blink惡意程式。第三個集群UAT-11988被高信度歸因為Qilin勒索軟體集團——先用CVE-2026-20316的靜態憑證登入取得低權限存取，再濫用FMC內建工具進行內部偵察(蒐集Active Directory服務帳戶憑證、MySQL憑證、主機名稱與IP對照表)，架設SOCKS代理與反向SSH通道把內部主機連回自己的基礎設施，最終部署Qilin勒索軟體。CISA已於9/9把CVE-2026-20079列入KEV目錄，要求聯邦文職機關9/12前完成修補；Cisco已針對FMC 7.0、7.2、7.4、7.6、7.7與10.0各發行線發布修補，且目前沒有能完全緩解此漏洞的暫時性因應措施。
summary.en: Cisco Talos disclosed on 9/9 that it is tracking three independent intrusion clusters exploiting two flaws in Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC, the control-plane software used to centrally manage a fleet of firewall appliances): CVE-2026-20079 (CVSS 10.0, an unauthenticated authentication bypass letting a remote attacker execute arbitrary commands as root) and CVE-2026-20316 (CVSS 5.3, letting an attacker log in directly using a built-in static, hardcoded credential for low-privilege access, chainable with the first flaw to escalate privileges). The first cluster, UAT-12197, exploits CVE-2026-20079 to plant a JSP web shell named home.jsp in Cisco Security Manager's Tomcat webroot, then deploys a Java-Archive-based command executor, cmd.jar, and abuses FMC's built-in OmniQuery.pl utility to query the users table and steal credentials. The second cluster, UAT-11823, has been attributed by Talos with high confidence to Sandworm, a group linked to Russian military intelligence, deploying Cyclops Blink — malware previously used to hijack networking devices such as WatchGuard firewalls into a botnet. The third cluster, UAT-11988, has been attributed with high confidence to Qilin ransomware affiliates — logging in via CVE-2026-20316's static credential for low-privilege access, then abusing FMC's built-in tools for internal reconnaissance (harvesting Active Directory service-account credentials, MySQL credentials, and hostname-to-IP mappings), staging a SOCKS proxy and reverse-SSH tunnel to reach back to their own infrastructure, and ultimately deploying Qilin ransomware. CISA added CVE-2026-20079 to its KEV catalog on 9/9, giving federal civilian agencies until 9/12 to patch; Cisco has shipped hotfixes across the FMC 7.0, 7.2, 7.4, 7.6, 7.7 and 10.0 release branches, and there is currently no workaround that fully mitigates the flaw short of patching.

implication.zh: Qilin正是本站8/28報告記錄過入侵ATF查案伺服器、9/6報告記錄過利用LiteLLM／MCP攻擊鏈打進AI閘道器的同一個勒索軟體集團——這次是它六週內第三種完全不同類型的入口(聯邦執法機關的獨立伺服器→企業內部AI閘道器→網路邊界的防火牆管理平面)，直接證實了9/6報告當時對Qilin目標選擇邏輯的判斷『找到值錢的存取權，而非鎖定特定產業』：這不是巧合的重複命中，是同一套邏輯持續在不同資產類別上驗證。這次真正新的地方，是Sandworm(長期被歸因於俄羅斯軍事情報總局、曾對烏克蘭電網發動破壞性攻擊的國家級組織)跟Qilin(單純逐利的犯罪集團)，在同一個披露窗口內，鎖定了完全同一個CVE。對威脅獵捕與provenance graph建模而言，這給了一個具體、可操作的論點：真正決定誰能進來的是漏洞本身，不是攻擊者的動機——當你在做修補優先順序評估時，不該因為『我的組織對國家級對手沒有吸引力』而把FMC這類漏洞排在較低順位，因為FMC控制平面對其管轄的每一台防火牆都握有高權限存取，一旦FMC本身被攻破，等於一次拿到整個受管防火牆艦隊的存取權，這個資產等級應該被視為Tier-0，跟你的威脅模型裡『誰最想打我』完全無關。
implication.en: Qilin is the same ransomware crew our 8/28 report documented breaching an ATF investigation-records server and our 9/6 report documented exploiting the LiteLLM/MCP chain into an AI gateway — this is its third completely different entry-point category in six weeks (a standalone federal law-enforcement server → an enterprise's internal AI gateway → the network perimeter's firewall management plane), directly confirming the read our 9/6 report already made of Qilin's targeting logic: 'wherever access is valuable,' not any one sector. This isn't a coincidental repeat hit — it's the same underlying logic being validated again on yet another asset class. What's genuinely new this round is that Sandworm (a nation-state group long attributed to Russian military intelligence, historically responsible for destructive attacks on Ukraine's power grid) and Qilin (a purely profit-driven criminal operation) converged on the exact same CVE within the same disclosure window. For threat hunting and provenance-graph modeling, this hands you a concrete, actionable point: what actually determines who gets in is the vulnerability itself, not the attacker's motive — when triaging patch priority, an organization shouldn't rank a flaw like this one lower just because it judges itself unattractive to nation-state adversaries, because the FMC control plane holds privileged access over every firewall it manages by design, and compromising FMC itself hands an attacker the entire managed fleet at once. That makes it a Tier-0 asset regardless of which category of adversary your own threat model considers most relevant.

counterpoint.zh: UAT-11988歸因於Qilin、UAT-11823歸因於Sandworm，目前都仍是Talos自身以手法重疊與基礎設施重複使用等證據做出的『高信度』研判，不是司法機關的正式起訴文件或攻擊者自己的承認，供應商層級的高信度歸因通常方向可靠，但偶爾會隨著更多證據出現而修正，不宜視為絕對定論。另外，CVE-2026-20079本身據部分資安部落格資料，實際上已從今年7月起就被追蹤與部分修補，這次9/9的新聞重點更多是三個活動集群的歸因分析首次公開，而非全新的零時差漏洞——若組織已依7月的KEV收錄要求完成修補，並不會因這次揭露而多出新的曝險。
counterpoint.en: The attribution of UAT-11988 to Qilin and UAT-11823 to Sandworm currently rests on Talos' own 'high confidence' judgment, based on evidence like tradecraft overlap and infrastructure reuse — not a formal law-enforcement indictment or the actors' own confirmation. Vendor-level high-confidence attribution is usually directionally reliable but occasionally gets revised as more evidence surfaces, so it shouldn't be treated as absolutely final. Separately, according to some security-vendor blogs, CVE-2026-20079 itself has reportedly been tracked and partially patched since around July; this cycle's 9/9 news is largely the public unveiling of the three clusters' attribution analysis, rather than a brand-new zero-day — organizations that already patched in response to the July KEV listing gain no new exposure from this disclosure.

items.source: Cisco Talos官方研究；CISA KEV目錄；經BleepingComputer、SecurityWeek、Help Net Security、The Hacker News轉述

title.zh: Reuters獨家：今年春天，美、英、挪三國海軍在Svalbard外海攔下正在演練『切斷海纜卻不留指紋』新技術的俄羅斯GUGI潛艦——這件事現在才第一次被公開
title.en: Reuters Exclusive: This Spring, US, UK and Norwegian Navies Intercepted Russian GUGI Submarines Rehearsing a 'Sever Cables Without Fingerprints' Capability Near Svalbard — Only Now Made Public for the First Time

summary.zh: Reuters獨家報導(9/10刊出)，今年春天，在Svalbard群島外海的北極水域，一次由美、英、挪威三國海軍組成的聯合行動，追蹤並攔阻了正在演練部署一項此前未公開技術的俄羅斯GUGI(俄羅斯海軍深海研究總局)潛艦——該技術設計用於切斷海底光纖電纜且不留下可供事後鑑識的痕跡。三國海軍在海上直接對峙俄方艦艇，使其未能完成演練並最終離開該海域。此次美方的直接參與、Svalbard這個具體地點，以及『切斷海纜卻不留痕跡』這項技術細節，此前均未曾公開；英國國防部此前僅在4/9的聲明中提到GUGI在挪威與英國海域附近曾有『試圖進行的秘密活動』，語氣較為概括。美、英均已對GUGI實施制裁。連接Svalbard與挪威本土的兩條海底光纖電纜，長度達1,400公里，部分路段深達2,700公尺。
summary.en: A Reuters exclusive published 9/10 reports that this spring, in Arctic waters off the Svalbard archipelago, a joint naval operation involving the US, UK and Norway tracked and confronted Russian GUGI (the Main Directorate of Deep-Sea Research) submarines that were rehearsing deployment of a previously undisclosed technology designed to sever undersea fiber-optic cables without leaving traces that could be forensically investigated afterward. The three navies directly confronted the Russian vessels at sea, preventing them from completing the exercise; the Russian ships ultimately left the area. The direct US involvement, the specific Svalbard location, and the 'sever cables without leaving traces' technical detail had not previously been made public; the UK's Ministry of Defence had previously only referenced, in a more general April 9 statement, GUGI's 'attempted covert activities' near Norwegian and British waters. Both the US and UK have sanctioned GUGI. The two subsea fiber-optic cables linking Svalbard to mainland Norway run 1,400km, with sections as deep as 2,700 metres.

implication.zh: 這條線索跟本站9/7週報談GNSS授時被拒斷後、provenance graph上『誰先誰後』這條因果邊會失真的核心論證，屬於同一個更大主題的另一個面向：海底電纜跟GNSS授時訊號一樣，都是設計上就該被信任的共用基礎設施，而破壞它的價值恰恰在於『可否認性』——但這次GUGI被觀察到在演練的，是一項刻意設計成『事後查不出痕跡』的技術，這比GNSS干擾(至少事後還可以被定位、測量、留下可追蹤的訊號紀錄)更難處理的一個層級：它的目標不是讓歸因變慢，而是讓歸因這個問題本身永遠沒有答案。這次行動在演練階段就被攔阻、且事隔五個多月才對外公開，說明西方海軍目前把這個領域的偵測與嚇阻能力當成需要保留、而非即時公開的情報資產——這代表對外公開的『攔阻／未攔阻』海底電纜破壞事件清單，幾乎必然低估了實際的行動頻率，因為被成功嚇阻的嘗試，本質上不會留下一條受損電纜讓人事後調查、也不會被急著公開。對你評估關鍵基礎設施韌性而言，接下來真正值得追蹤的指標，與其說是『又有幾條電纜被切斷』，不如說是西方海軍與情報體系投入多少頻寬持續壓制這項特定能力被實際使用——這件事本身雖然不容易被量化，卻比事後統計受損電纜數量更貼近這場對抗的真實狀態。
implication.en: This connects to the same broader theme as our 9/7 weekly's core argument about GNSS denial corrupting the 'what-came-first' causal edge in a provenance graph: undersea cables, like GNSS timing signals, are shared infrastructure that is trusted by design, and the value of disrupting them lies precisely in deniability. What GUGI was observed rehearsing here, though, is a technology deliberately engineered so that no trace remains to investigate afterward — a harder category than GNSS jamming, whose interference can at least be located, measured and logged after the fact. The goal here isn't to slow down attribution; it's to make the question of attribution permanently unanswerable. That this operation was stopped at the rehearsal stage, and only disclosed publicly more than five months later, tells you Western navies are currently treating detection-and-deterrence capability in this domain as intelligence to be preserved rather than announced in real time — which means any public tally of 'foiled vs. completed' undersea-cable sabotage almost certainly understates the real operational tempo, since a successfully deterred attempt, by its nature, leaves no damaged cable to investigate and generates no urgency to disclose. For assessing critical-infrastructure resilience, the metric actually worth tracking going forward isn't 'how many more cables got cut' — it's how much naval and intelligence-community bandwidth is continuously being spent to keep this specific capability from ever being used. That's harder to quantify, but it's closer to the real state of this contest than a post-hoc count of damaged cables would be.

counterpoint.zh: 這則報導的核心細節——Svalbard地點、美方直接參與、以及『切斷海纜卻不留痕跡』的技術本身——目前主要來自Reuters匿名官員來源的敘述，唯一有具名政府背書的部分，是英國國防部4/9那份較為概括的『試圖進行秘密活動』聲明，並未明確證實這次演練的具體地點或武器細節。考慮到公開確認具體攔截行動涉及高度敏感的情報與外交考量，不能排除部分細節是刻意選擇在此時對外釋出、用於對外展示西方偵測能力的嚇阻性宣傳，而非對整起事件完整、中立的敘述。
counterpoint.en: The core details of this report — the Svalbard location, direct US involvement, and the 'sever cables without leaving traces' technology itself — currently rest primarily on Reuters' anonymous-official sourcing. The only on-record government confirmation is the UK Ministry of Defence's more general April 9 statement about 'attempted covert activities,' which doesn't specifically confirm this rehearsal's exact location or the weapon's technical details. Given how diplomatically and intelligence-sensitive confirming a specific interception operation would be, it's plausible some details were deliberately surfaced now as deterrence-signaling — demonstrating Western detection capability — rather than as a complete, neutral account of everything that happened.

items.source: Reuters獨家報導；經Defense News、Euronews、Honolulu Star-Advertiser轉述；英國國防部4/9聲明

title.zh: 美方對中國的先進HBM出口管制，現在正幫Huawei跟Cambricon把自家晶片價格調高：灰市記憶體吃掉了國產替代方案20%到50%的成本優勢
title.en: Washington's Advanced-HBM Export Controls Are Now Helping Huawei and Cambricon Raise Their Own Chip Prices: Grey-Market Memory Is Eating 20-50% of the Domestic Alternative's Cost Advantage

summary.zh: Reuters獨家報導(9/10刊出)，Huawei已將其Ascend 950DT AI加速卡的報價上調至25萬人民幣(約3.7萬美元)以上，較兩個月前對客戶的報價上漲20%至50%(依合約條件不同)；Cambricon也將其新一代晶片(暫稱690)的報價上調20%至30%。價格上漲的根本原因是HBM(高頻寬記憶體，AI加速器成本結構中占比極高的關鍵零組件)供給短缺：自美國2024年底起收緊對中國出口先進HBM後，中國晶片廠商日益仰賴灰市管道取得HBM，而灰市價格通常是美、韓等地買家所付價格的數倍。由於記憶體占AI加速卡生產成本的比重極高，這波成本上漲已直接反映到終端成品報價上。另有報導指出，北京同時要求境內大型科技公司避免採購即使已獲美方核准出口的Nvidia晶片(如H200)，Nvidia來自中國的資料中心營收占比已降至其總營收不到1%。
summary.en: A Reuters exclusive published 9/10 reports that Huawei has raised the indicated price of its Ascend 950DT AI accelerator card to above ¥250,000 (about US$37,255), a 20-50% increase from prices quoted to customers just two months ago depending on contract terms; Cambricon has similarly raised the price of its next-generation chip (tentatively named the 690) by 20-30%. The root cause is a shortage of HBM (High Bandwidth Memory, a component that makes up a large share of an AI accelerator's cost structure): since Washington tightened controls on advanced HBM exports to China in late 2024, Chinese chipmakers have increasingly relied on grey-market channels for HBM, which typically costs several times what buyers in the US or South Korea pay. Because memory accounts for a large share of an AI accelerator's production cost, this cost increase is feeding directly into finished-card prices. Separate reporting notes that Beijing is simultaneously directing its largest tech firms to avoid purchasing Nvidia chips even where Washington has approved the sale (such as the H200), and Nvidia's China data-center revenue has fallen to under 1% of its total data-center revenue.

implication.zh: 這給了一個具體的價格訊號，證明美方出口管制目前起作用的機制，跟外界常討論的『壓制中國AI運算能力』不完全是同一件事：Huawei與Cambricon顯然還是能取得晶片製造產能，真正被卡住的是記憶體——瓶頸從『運算邏輯層』往上移了一層，移到『記憶體供應層』，而且移動的證據極其清楚：兩個月內20%到50%的報價漲幅，對硬體市場而言是異常快、異常陡的訊號。對你關注台灣科技供應鏈與相關個股的意義是，這給出了一個具體、可追蹤的觀察窗口：任何能合法對非中國市場銷售HBM或相關封裝產能的台灣供應鏈廠商(封測、基板、先進封裝相關業者)，目前正處在這個供給缺口的核心；如果能觀察到來自灰市中間商的異常急單或提前拉貨訊號，這會是判斷HBM實際配額緊俏程度的領先指標，比任何一份公開的出口管制清單都更貼近市場真實狀態。同時值得記住，這波漲價本身還混合了另一個變數：北京要求境內大廠避開已獲核准的Nvidia晶片，代表即使美方鬆綁，中國的採購決策也未必單純依成本效益計算，政治考量本身可能持續壓抑這類市場化價格訊號原本該有的修正力道。
implication.en: This gives a concrete price signal confirming that the mechanism through which US export controls are currently biting isn't quite the same as the commonly discussed 'suppress China's AI compute capacity' story: Huawei and Cambricon can clearly still get chips fabricated — what's actually constrained is memory. The bottleneck has moved up one layer, from compute logic to memory supply, and the evidence for that move is unusually clear: a 20-50% price jump within two months is an unusually fast, unusually steep signal for a hardware market. For anyone watching Taiwan's tech supply chain and related equities, this hands you a concrete, trackable window: any Taiwan-based supply-chain player able to legally sell HBM or related packaging capacity into non-China markets — assembly/test, substrate, advanced-packaging players — currently sits at the center of this supply gap. Any sign of unusual rush orders or pulled-forward buying from grey-market intermediaries would be a leading indicator of just how tight actual HBM allocation is running, closer to the market's real state than any public export-control list. Worth keeping in mind too: this price surge is entangled with a second variable — Beijing directing its major firms to avoid even Washington-approved Nvidia chips — meaning China's own procurement decisions may not be a pure cost-efficiency calculation even where the US relaxes controls, and political considerations could keep suppressing the correction that a market-based price signal like this one would otherwise produce.

counterpoint.zh: 兩個月內20%到50%的報價漲幅是強烈訊號，但本身不足以直接證明中國AI運算產能已經跟不上國內需求——Huawei與Cambricon也可能只是在需求缺乏彈性(國家隊採購、政策扶植的必買清單)的情況下，順勢擴大自身利潤空間，價格上漲未必單純是成本轉嫁，也可能混雜了定價權的成分。此外，北京要求大廠避開已核准的Nvidia晶片這件事本身說明，中國的晶片採購決策目前仍以政治考量為第一順位，而非純粹的成本效率計算——這代表就算灰市HBM價格未來回落，這類政治性採購限制也可能不會隨之鬆綁，兩個變數不宜混為一談去推論同一個方向的市場結果。
counterpoint.en: A 20-50% price jump within two months is a strong signal, but it doesn't by itself prove China's AI compute capacity is falling short of domestic demand — Huawei and Cambricon could simply be expanding their own margins while facing inelastic demand (state-directed procurement, mandatory-purchase lists for national champions), meaning the price rise may reflect pricing power as much as pure cost pass-through. Separately, the fact that Beijing is directing major firms to avoid even Washington-approved Nvidia chips shows China's chip-procurement decisions currently still put political considerations first, ahead of pure cost efficiency — meaning even if grey-market HBM prices ease later, this kind of politically-driven purchasing restriction may not loosen in step. The two variables shouldn't be conflated into inferring one single market direction.

items.source: Reuters獨家報導；經Investing.com、Yahoo Finance、24/7 Wall St.轉述
